maker_fills_are_charged.quote: Maker fees are charged for orders placed that are not immediately matched and are instead left as resting orders on the orderbook. These fees are only charged when a trade is ultimately executed, there are no fees associated with canceling a resting order.
maker_fills_are_charged.implication: Refutes tools/net_yield_logger.py:109 ('LIP maker orders are fee-free per Kalshi', uncited). The conservative default charge_maker=True is correct and now has a source.

fee_rounding.value: ceil to $0.000001 (6dp), NOT to the whole cent
fee_rounding.quote: Trade fee: ceil_6dp(model_fee) - rounded up to the nearest $0.000001. Aligned change: floor_precision(revenue - trade_fee) floored to the user's target balance precision ($0.01 for non-direct members). Rounding fee = (revenue - trade_fee) - aligned_change. Net fee = trade fee + rounding fee - rebate, constrained non-negative.
fee_rounding.implication: engine/fees.py rounded each fill UP TO THE NEXT WHOLE CENT. For the small fills a LIP maker gets that is the dominant term and overstates cost by orders of magnitude (1 contract @5c: 0.3325c raw -> 1c). The repo swung from understating fees to overstating them.

fee_rate_constant.reason: kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf returned HTTP 429 (rate limited) on repeated attempts. A search summary reported tier-0 maker 5.0bps / taker 12.0bps, but that is a summary, may describe the perps schedule, and is not a verbatim reading of the schedule. Not promoted.
fee_rate_constant.consequence: verified=False stands. Any profitability number remains fee-assumption-dependent and must say so.
